name: Jharkhand Mukti Morcha
description: The Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) is a regional political party primarily based in Jharkhand. Founded in 1972 by Shibu Soren, Binod Bihari Mahato and A. K. Roy, the party emerged from the movement for a separate Jharkhand state and the rights of tribal communities. JMM focuses on tribal welfare, protection of indigenous rights, regional development, social justice, land rights and environmental protection. The party has played a central role in Jharkhand politics and has formed the state government multiple times.
achievements: Played a historic role in the movement for creation of Jharkhand state.
Jharkhand was formed as a separate state in 2000 after decades of regional movements.
Focused on welfare schemes for tribal communities and economically weaker sections.
Implemented initiatives related to rural development and social security.
Promoted protection of tribal culture, traditions and land rights.
Expanded political representation of tribal communities in Jharkhand.
Introduced welfare programmes including housing, education and livelihood support.
criticisms: Opposition parties have criticised JMM leaders over corruption allegations.
Critics have raised concerns about illegal mining and land-related issues.
Opponents have questioned governance and development outcomes in Jharkhand.
The party has faced criticism regarding internal family-based leadership.
Political rivals have accused the party of focusing heavily on identity politics.
protests: Led movements for creation of a separate Jharkhand state.
Campaigns for tribal rights and protection of indigenous communities.
Protests against displacement due to mining and industrial projects.
Movements supporting land rights under tribal protection laws.
Campaigns for employment and development opportunities in Jharkhand.
timeline: 1972 - Jharkhand Mukti Morcha founded to represent Jharkhand regional interests.
1980s - JMM became a major force in the Jharkhand statehood movement.
1990s - Party continued its demand for a separate Jharkhand state.
2000 - Jharkhand became a separate state from Bihar.
2005 - JMM participated in Jharkhand government formation.
2009 - JMM leader Shibu Soren became Chief Minister of Jharkhand.
2013 - JMM formed government in Jharkhand with Congress support.
2019 - JMM-led alliance won Jharkhand Assembly election; Hemant Soren became Chief Minister.
2024 - Hemant Soren returned to Jharkhand politics after legal challenges and JMM continued as a major state party.
2024 - JMM-led alliance retained power in Jharkhand Assembly election.
